purpose: Common six-model PTQ candidate preserving the encoder and duration path after reported clipped syllables in the existing selective INT8 demo.

keep_original_precision.note: Preserve integer shape/index/mask types; FP32 does not mean casting int64 inputs or shape operations to float. Retaining a nonlinear operation in FP32 does not undo quantization error from adjacent convolutions.

proposed_nncf_settings.calibration_split: canonical train only, checked against split and dataset rows
proposed_nncf_settings.note: Keep the previous settings for the first scope ablation. Verify effective per-channel weight quantization and executed INT8 kernels; do not infer them solely from preset MIXED. This JSON is a protocol, not a drop-in argument for the existing suite.

validation.selection_data: canonical validation text; freeze IDs, normalizer, scorer and seeds before synthesis; do not tune on Harvard-720 or canonical test
validation.comparison: same text and explicit matched duration/acoustic noise, three fixed seeds; also check native deployment graphs separately
validation.note: Limits are engineering proposals, not proof of perceptual equivalence or expected speedup. Report paired confidence intervals; an inconclusive interval does not certify equivalence. Quality failures reject promotion even if RTF improves.
